chapter1.label: 01 / Story
chapter1.paragraph: We believe a great table is not only about what we eat, but who we share it with.

chapter2.label: 02 / Kitchen
chapter2.paragraph: Ingredient comes before showmanship. We choose what's in season, meet it with fire, and touch it as little as possible.
chapter2.imageAlt: Fire and grill in Ay'la kitchen

chapter3.label: 03 / Table

chapter3.quote: Because some evenings are lived not for the meal,

chapter4.label: 04 / Ay'la
chapter4.description: Reserve a table for good food, good people and long evenings.

socialProof.label: Our Guests
socialProof.description: A few lines from guests who spent their evening at Ay'la.
socialProof.curatedReviewsNote: Rating and review count are live from Google. Sample quotes reflect guest experiences — read all reviews on Google.

reviews.name: Elif K.
reviews.text: One of the best dinner spots we've found in Alanya. The mezze is fresh, the meat is cooked just right. The staff is attentive without being pushy — perfect if you want to enjoy the evening at your own pace.

reviews.name: Markus W.
reviews.text: Wonderful atmosphere, especially on the terrace at sunset. You must try the Çökertme kebab. Staff speaks English, which makes things easy for visitors.

reviews.name: Anna & David
reviews.text: We booked online and our table was ready when we arrived. Loved the pumpkin dessert and the fajita. Better value than many restaurants around Alanya.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Directions, reservations, payment and allergens — what guests ask most.

items.q: How do I get there and is there parking?
items.a: Kadıpaşa, Sugözü Cd. No:10 — near central Alanya / Kleopatra. Easy by taxi or car. Street parking is limited; nearby lots are recommended.
Online bookings are available up to {maxDays} days ahead. For parties of {threshold}+ please call us. To cancel or change, call {phone}.
Cash or card at the table. There is no online payment.
Please tell our staff before ordering if you have allergies or dietary requirements — the kitchen will help.

privacy.metaDescription: Ay'la Food & More privacy policy and personal data protection.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Ay'la Food & More we use information you share through our website and reservation service only to provide our service and stay in touch with you.

sections.title: Information we collect
paragraphs: Through the reservation form we may collect name, phone, email and optional notes.
Anonymous visit data (page views, device type) may be processed for website analytics.

sections.title: How we use information
paragraphs: To confirm your reservation, plan seating and contact you when necessary.
To measure service quality and improve the website experience.

sections.title: Sharing and retention
paragraphs: We do not sell personal data. Information may be shared only with service providers (hosting, email) or authorities when legally required.
Reservation records are kept for operational needs, then deleted or anonymised.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Contact us at reservation@aylaalanya.com regarding your data protection rights.

kvkk.metaDescription: Ay'la Food & More personal data protection notice under Turkish KVKK.
kvkk.title: KVKK Disclosure Notice
kvkk.intro: Under Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data ("KVKK"), Ay'la Food & More informs you as the data controller.

sections.title: Data controller
paragraphs: Ay'la Food & More — Kadıpaşa, Sugözü Cd. No:10, 07400 Alanya/Antalya. reservation@aylaalanya.com

sections.title: Personal data processed
paragraphs: Identity and contact: full name, phone, email.
Transaction security: IP address, cookie/analytics data (anonymous).
Reservation: date, time, party size, special notes.

sections.title: Purposes and legal basis
paragraphs: Customer relations and legitimate interest in service improvement.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Under KVKK Art. 11 you may request information, correction, deletion, objection and lodge a complaint.
